relations.subject: Denma Locho Rinpoche
relations.evidence: At age twelve, at the insistence of Tongpun Rinpoche, Denma Locho Rinpoche entered Drepung Loseling Monastic College outside Lhasa... He obtained his Lharampa Geshe degree

relations.subject: Denma Locho Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Denma Locho Rinpoche entered Drepung Loseling Monastic College outside Lhasa and studied with Tongpun Rinpoche until he departed for China a few years later.

relations.subject: Denma Locho Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Thereafter, he was tutored by Gen Nyima Gyaltsen.

relations.subject: Denma Locho Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He then completed his tantric exams at Gyume Tantric College in 1958.

relations.subject: Denma Locho Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Rinpoche lived in Sarnath for two years, then became a research fellow at Calcutta University for two years

relations.subject: Denma Locho Rinpoche
relations.evidence: and then principal of the Buddhist School of Dialectics in Ladakh for six years.

relations.subject: Denma Locho Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Rinpoche was Abbot of the Dalai Lama's Namgyal Monastery from 1986 to 1991.

relations.subject: Denma Locho Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Rinpoche first came to the United States in 1978 where he taught for one year at the University of Virginia in Charlottesville.

relations.subject: Denma Locho Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Locho Rinpoche received many teachings from the late Venerable Ling Rinpoche, the senior tutor to the Dalai Lama

relations.subject: 7th Kyabjé Yongzin Ling Rinpoche
relations.evidence: the Dalai Lama appointed Rinpoche as his tutor.

relations.subject: Denma Locho Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Rinpoche's principal gurus were Lithang Kyabgon (Shogdrung Rinpoche)

relations.subject: Denma Locho Rinpoche
relations.evidence: and Lhatsung Dorje Chang, "the two masters from whom Rinpoche received the unique lineages of Manjushri/Yamantaka and Vajrayogini that came to define him;"

relations.subject: Denma Locho Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Rinpoche's principal gurus were... Trijang Dorje Chang;

relations.subject: Denma Locho Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Rinpoche's principal gurus were... and the Fourteenth Dalai Lama.

relations.subject: Kyabje Gelek Rimpoche
relations.evidence: He was teacher of Kyabje Gelek Rimpoche and Lama Zopa Rinpoche.
